48| 		pts = { Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(1, 0, -0.2) }
49| 	end

51| 	for i = 2, #pts do
52| 		total += (pts[i] - pts[i - 1]).Magnitude

55| 		pts = { Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) }
